title: Jr Database Administrator
job_description:
Requirements Minimum bachelor’s degree in computer engineering, computer science or equivalent. At least 1-3 years of working experience and proven work experience as a Jr. DBA. Knowledge of database technologies, backup procedures, recovery systems and SQL. Strong SQL skills with the ability to write, optimize and troubleshoot complex SQL queries. Proficiency in data manipulation languages, including Oracle and MS SQL Database. Working experience with high availability configurations such as RAC, installation, configuration, administration of ASM and cluster control is advantageous. Preferably candidates with strong problem-solving skills, good analytical thinker, organization skills and self-initiative. Up to date with trends and developments in database administration. Capable of working under pressure. Ability to work independently and meet project timelines

Oracle software installation and maintenance Monitoring system performance and identifying problems that arise. Reporting on metrics regarding usage and performance. Responding in a timely manner to user-reported errors. Protecting the database against threats or unauthorized access. Ensuring that the database is adequately backed up and able to be recovered in the event of data loss or corruption. Suggesting changes and improvements for database maintenance or protection. Liaising with various project teams including IT Project Manager and database programmers. Support application development teams in their production deployments. Assist with root cause analysis (RCA) of production database issues and work towards long-term solutions. Work with Oracle Support for system issues that require product support. Log service requests and follow up for resolution of critical issues in a timely fashion. Prioritize resolving database and database server related security vulnerability findings in a timely fashion. Setup and monitor database backup jobs and work on PROD to NON-PROD database refresh tasks. Monitor database alert notifications, transaction volumes, server and database space utilization, backup jobs and take timely/preventive action before production issues are caused. Providing training to users

EPF/SOCSO Medical Claims Laptop Provided Casual Attire Any other benefits discuss when interview
